our_method_vs_primary.verdict: EXP0026 fixed a bilinear kd/sun_irradiance optimization-coupling instability (separate, 10x slower learning rate for the sun term) that was causing EXP0025's wide, non-monotonic swing. At the matched 200-step budget (same as EXP0019's own protocol), our method's contamination (+0.21/+0.28pp) is now smaller in magnitude than SGS-Intrinsic's (-0.43/-1.20pp) on BOTH heldout views -- a clean, if narrow and single-scene, win. Still non-monotonic across step counts (400/1000 worse than 200/600), so 200 steps is the best observed point, not a proven-optimal setting; no further hyperparameter search performed to avoid overfitting one tiny scene. Absolute albedo accuracy remains saturated at every budget. 1 room/1 seed/oracle sun direction -- see SUNPATCH_DAYLIGHT_METHOD_ZH.md for the full honest scope
